beta.notes:
New in this version:
• When automatic analysis cannot finish, Buddy offers clearer recovery choices, manual review, and a diagnostic-report button, with technical details tucked away.

Fixes:
• AI recovery now runs in the background with cancellation and a time limit, keeping the document available for review.
• Failed automatic grading now preserves existing grades and comments instead of replacing them with empty results or showing fallback full credit.
• Recovery no longer retries a different submission if you switch documents while AI is starting.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
